title: Financial measurement contract (PROPOSED, not dev8 runtime)
summary: Proposed evidence-gated reconciliation: forecast saving, paper commitment, accrued operational estimate and externally verified realized saving must remain distinct. Only certified consumption/billing evidence and like-for-like counterfactual pricing can establish realized saving.
invariants: PROPOSED ONLY: dev8 does not implement invoice ingestion, provider settlement, cash purchase or realized-savings accounting.
Currency conversion needs timestamped FX provenance; tax, credits, support fees, regional commitments and billing adjustments must be explicit.
The baseline must be specified before looking at outcome, avoiding cherry-picked savings.
Counterfactual comparison must use same SLO, completion horizon, availability risk and region/jurisdiction constraints.
Missing billed quantity or FX rate is UNKNOWN, never $0.
Reconciliation must tolerate delayed invoices and corrections through append-only evidence, never overwrite earlier truth.

provenance.claim: Cloud Economics v0.1-dev8 source evidence; status=PROPOSED.

procedure: Define case_id, job_id, intention/policy digest, unmanaged comparator, service scope, measurement period and evidence cutoff.
Link decision receipts, native placements, checkpoints, observed usage and provider charge line identifiers without granting new execution authority.
Calculate anticipated_cost and its uncertainty separately from recognized_charge.
Reconcile provider invoice units, currency, tax, credits, exact bytes, duration and source adjustment refs.
Only then compute realized_savings = valid_comparator_cost - verified_managed_total, with residual/unmatched charges visible.
Represent disputes and correction lineage, including when realized savings cannot yet be stated.
